failedAssertions.reason: theme-transitions.css is not imported into the React app's index.css. Theme changes are instant (0s transition-duration) instead of smooth 0.3s transitions. The legacy theme-transitions.css defines proper transitions but is only loaded in legacy CSS files (styles.css, promotion-styles.css). Fix: add transition CSS rules to src/index.css.
